triggers.expected: Fires, fetches, prunes, and fast-forwards the base branch.

triggers.prompt: 更新一下代码，跟 main 对齐
Get me up to date with the remote.
triggers.expected: Fires, and reports a diverged branch rather than rebasing it.
Fires on a second Chinese phrasing, not only the one the description spells out first.

non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; landing a change is a different loop step.

non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; removing merged branches belongs elsewhere.

non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. That is shipping, and Chinese phrasing must not blur the boundary English phrasing keeps.

behaviors.prompt: Sync this repo. The current branch feat/parser is 3 commits ahead of its upstream and 7 behind, and main is 12 behind origin/main.
expectations: Reports feat/parser as diverged, 3 ahead and 7 behind, without rebasing, merging, or resetting it.
States that choosing between rebase and merge is the user's call instead of picking one.

behaviors.prompt: Sync. I am on main, main is 4 behind origin/main, and I have uncommitted edits to src/parser.rs.
expectations: Does not stash, commit, or discard the uncommitted edits.
Explains that git merge --ff-only refuses when the incoming commits touch a modified file, and that the refusal leaves the working tree exactly as it was.
Names src/parser.rs rather than reporting a skip without saying what blocked it.

behaviors.prompt: Sync. I am on feat/api, and main is checked out in a second worktree at ../review.
expectations: Reports main as skipped and names ../review as the worktree holding it.
Treats it as a normal outcome, not an error or a failed run.
Does not detach, remove, or check anything out to work around it.

behaviors.prompt: Sync --all. Of six local branches: two are strictly behind, one is 2 ahead and 1 behind, one has no upstream, one is marked [gone], and one is the branch I am standing on.
expectations: Fast-forwards only the two strictly behind branches.
Skips the diverged branch, the one with no upstream, the [gone] branch, and the checked-out branch, giving each its own reason.
Deletes nothing, and points the [gone] branch at cleanup rather than removing it here.

behaviors.prompt: 同步一下，看看现在跟远端差多少
expectations: Reports in Chinese, because that is the language of the question.
Reports ahead and behind the right way round — commits only on the local branch are ahead, commits only on the upstream are behind.
Fast-forwards only, and reports a diverged branch instead of rebasing it.
